description: Detect LLM text watermark evidence: green-list z-test for a key you hold, plus invisible-character markers — Tests whether text carries watermark evidence, for a pipeline that must decide whether to trust or label content. Two independent checks: (1) a green-list z-test (Kirchenbauer et al. 2023) over green flags you supply, or over token ids and a key using this endpoint's own HMAC-SHA256 scheme, returning the z-score and exact binomial p-value; (2) an invisible-character scan of the text for zero-width

gamma.description: Expected green fraction under no watermark. Default 0.25.

greenFlags.description: One 0/1 per scored token: 1 when your own detector's green list contains the token. Deduplicate repeated n-grams yourself if your scheme requires it.

key.description: Secret key for tokenIds. Used for this call only and never stored or echoed.

minTokens.description: Fewer scored tokens than this is unknown. Default 25.

scheme.description: Scheme for tokenIds; default and only value.

text.description: Text to scan for invisible markers.

tokenIds.description: Token ids in order (at most 5000). Green membership is computed from the key with the hmac-sha256-green-1 scheme; each distinct consecutive pair is scored once.

zThreshold.description: z at or above which the result is fail. Default 4 (Kirchenbauer et al.).

name: llm-watermark-detector
